#   url       : SDES download URL (any of the indicator's URLs is fine).
#   sheet     : worksheet path / name (e.g. xl/worksheets/sheet4.xml).
#   yearRow   : 1-based row whose cells hold the year headers (e.g. "2023").
#   valueRow  : 1-based row holding the numeric values. Empty when using the
#               label mode below.
#   labelCol  : 1-based column holding the series label (label mode).
#   labelValue: substring to match in labelCol (label mode). Preferred over a
#               fixed valueRow because the row number drifts across revisions.
#   extraCol  : (optional) 1-based column whose cell must also contain extraVal
#               (e.g. col 5 = NIVGEO "France"
#   extraVal  : substring required in extraCol.
#   extraCol2 : (optional) second disambiguation column.
#   extraVal2 : substring required in extraCol2.
#   exact     : 1 => labelValue must equal the label cell (not "contains").
#               Use when several rows share a label prefix (e.g. aggregate
#               "Production nette d'électricité" vs "...nucléaire vendue").
#   tolerance : min absolute |source - Grist| considered a copy error
#               (default 0.05); a year must exceed BOTH this and relTol below
#               to be flagged COPY.
#   relTol    : relative floor (fraction of |Grist|) for a copy error
#               (default 0.03). Absorbs normal SDES annual revisions that are
#               NOT copy errors while still catching gross transcription
#               mistakes.
#   verified  : yes => coordinates manually/LLM verified against Grist.
#     A row WITHOUT verified=yes and/or without coordinates is treated as
#     DRAFT: extraction runs but every result is flagged "à confirmer".
